sovereign_country.strategic_role: 泛欧数字贸易门户、极速低成本在线设立与新锐EMI银行开户

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of PC and Console Video Games via Digital Stores

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Cayman Islands Companies Act (Revised), sections 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11 and 26; Tax Concessions Act (Revised), sections 6 and 7
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Cayman Islands General Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Declaration of Compliance under section 7
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required; authorized capital may be US$50,000 or higher without additional duty. No escrow account or paid-up capital deposit is required prior to filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the Company adopt and approve the minutes of incorporation, and the subscription by the subscriber of one ordinary share of no par value is hereby accepted and the share is allotted as fully paid. (2) That the registered office of the Company shall be situate at the address of the licensed registered office provider in the Cayman Islands, and that provider is appointed registered office and registered agent. (3) That each person named in the Consent to Act, namely [Director 1], [Director 2] and [Company Secretary], are appointed as first directors and secretary of the Company. (4) That the board is authorised to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and take all actions to effect the Company's commencement of operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Excluded Status Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Registry, Office of the Registrar of Companies, Grand Cayman
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit via a licensed Registered Agent to the Companies Registry. Provide up to three alternative names and confirm that the proposed name is not similar to any existing company. If the name includes restricted words, the agent must obtain regulatory clearance or a legal opinion.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and two alternates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for resemblance to an existing company, submit revised names and pay the resubmission fee; if restricted words are flagged, submit a letter of consent from the relevant regulator.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutive Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association based on the Cayman Islands standard forms. Have the subscriber execute the M&A and each proposed director sign a Consent to Act. Notarize the subscriber's signature and obtain a notarial certificate from a law firm licensed in the Cayman Islands, or the registered agent's notary. If the subscriber is a body corporate, provide its certificate of incorporation and incumbency.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarial authentication is rejected or incomplete, remedy the document execution and restart the notarial procedure; any missing signature or witness page is corrected before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing the Incorporation Application with the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cayman Islands Registrar of Companies (eRegistry portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the application electronically through the eRegistry portal. Attach the executed M&A, Declaration of Compliance, Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent, and proof of government fee payment. The agent verifies the details and submits the application to the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Signed and witnessed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar raises a requisition or query, the agent must correct the specific form, file an amended Declaration of Compliance, and remedy any technical defect within 14 days; most errors are cured by re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Charter Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon final approval, the Registrar registers the M&A and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent retrieves the certified copy of the Certificate and the Registrar-stamped M&A, and places them in the company's statutory register.
required_dossiers: Registrar-stamped Memorandum and Articles of Association
Company Extract from the Companies Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains typographical or factual errors, apply through the registered agent for administrative correction under section 11 of the Companies Act; a corrected certificate will be issued without affecting the original incorporation date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting / Written Resolution and Corporate Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or adopt a written resolution under the M&A. Pass the pro-forma board resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments. Issue share certificates, open bank accounts, and adopt any required corporate books.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer appointment is invalid because the Consent to Act was not signed or dated, execute a retrospective consent and date it as of the appointment date; confirm in the meeting minutes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Gibraltar External Registration (if establishing a place of business in Gibraltar)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House, Registry of Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If the Cayman exempted company establishes a physical place of business or habitual commercial presence in Gibraltar, file Form C1 under the Gibraltar Companies Act together with certified Cayman incorporation documents, certified M&A, register of directors, and a local service address. If the company exclusively distributes software through digital stores such as Steam and PlayStation without physical operations in Gibraltar, this registration is not required.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Cayman Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association
Local agent consent and service address details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected, cure any defect in the certified translations, apostilles, or legalization of the Cayman documents, and refile. Late filing penalties are avoided if the application is submitted within 30 days of establishing the Gibraltar place of business.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None — the digital publishing and distribution of PC and console video games through Steam and PlayStation Store does not constitute an industrial activity subject to factory or process licensing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating or manufacturing licence is required in the Cayman Islands or Gibraltar for this undertaking.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Climate Change, Gibraltar (if a physical Gibraltar office is established)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — digital software publishing does not trigger an Environmental Impact Assessment; under the Gibraltar Environmental Protection Act, office-only operations fall outside the mandatory EIA schedule.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, particulate, or industrial waste discharges are generated by the software publishing business. Any administrative office must comply with Gibraltar waste management and municipal wastewater connection regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to virtual digital operations. If a Gibraltar or Cayman office is opened, fire safety certification, structural load inspection, and workplace occupational health and safety clearance must be obtained from the relevant local Building Control and Fire Safety authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: HM Government of Gibraltar - Income Tax Office (Commissioner of Income Tax) for direct, corporate and residence taxes; HM Customs Gibraltar (Customs and Immigration Department) for indirect taxes, customs duties and Purchase Tax. Official portal: https://www.gibraltartax.gov.gi and https://www.customs.gov.gi.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Cayman Exempted Company is not automatically Gibraltar-tax registered. It must apply to the Commissioner of Income Tax using Form 1 (Application for Registration as a Body of Persons/Taxpayer) within 30 days of commencing a taxable activity, submitting: (1) certified Cayman Certificate of Incorporation and Register of Directors/Members, (2) memorandum and articles of association, (3) a Gibraltar registered office address, (4) identity and residence details of beneficial owners/directors for AML/CRS/FATCA compliance, and (5) a Gibraltar tax representative appointment. The Income Tax Office issues a local TIN reference number. Gibraltar is outside the EU VAT area, so no EU VAT registration number is available; for Purchase Tax/Customs purposes, registration with HM Customs is made through the customs registration form (SAD Reg) to obtain a Customs/Trade Identification Number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Gibraltar does not operate a US-style check-the-box or fiscal-transparency election. The Cayman Exempted Company may hold a Cayman Tax Exemption Undertaking (15-20 years) but that has no effect on Gibraltar taxation. Under Gibraltar law, a non-resident company is subject to entity-level territorial taxation at 12.5% on Gibraltar-source income; if central management and control is in Gibraltar, worldwide profits are taxed. A company may apply for a formal residence ruling. Anti-hybrid rules under the Income Tax (International Tax Compliance) Regulations align with OECD/UK standards and do not permit elective disregarded treatment; no elective hybrid mismatch filing is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Sales and Use Tax (Gibraltar Purchase Tax under the Purchase Tax Ordinance; customs/import duties under the Customs Ordinance; Gibraltar does not operate a VAT/GST system)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic turnover threshold under Purchase Tax law; registration for Purchase Tax/Customs is obligatory for any business importing or selling taxable goods in Gibraltar, irrespective of turnover (GIP/GBP). Digital-only supplies by a non-resident Cayman company such as Steam publishing are outside the scope of Purchase Tax registration unless physical goods are imported into Gibraltar. For direct tax, any company carrying on a business in Gibraltar must register for Gross Income Tax even with zero turnover; the statutory deadline is 30 days from commencement.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Gibraltar has no real-time e-invoicing clearance, mandatory digital stamping, or SAF-T filing regime. HM Customs operates an electronic Single Administrative Document (SAD) portal for import/export declarations. Electronic invoices are acceptable if they contain supplier name/address, invoice number, description, quantity, rate and tax amount where applicable; records must be retained for at least 6 years for audit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: As Gibraltar does not operate VAT, there is no '0% VAT rate'. Goods physically exported from Gibraltar are outside the scope of Purchase Tax and are entitled to customs duty relief/suspension provided export occurs within 180 days and the exporter holds an approved Customs Export Certificate. Electronically supplied services by the Cayman Exempted Company for PC/console game publishing via Steam (Valve Corporation) and PlayStation Store (Sony Interactive Entertainment) are outside the scope of Gibraltar Purchase Tax because the supplies are made to consumers outside Gibraltar and effectively used outside Gibraltar; no zero-rating certificate or refund mechanism is required for such digital services.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD/C88) for physical goods or platform-service statement for digital exports
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing removal of goods from Gibraltar
Commercial invoice from the Gibraltar-registered entity to the foreign buyer/platform
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 evidencing receipt of export proceeds through Steam/Valve payout and PlayStation Store payout rails
Licence and contract documentation for Steam Publishing and PlayStation Store digital distribution
Certificate of Origin or supporting transfer pricing documentation where related parties are involved
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: HM Customs and the Income Tax Office may audit export files, cancel export relief, and clawback uncollected duty/tax with retrospective effect for up to 6 years. False declarations attract penalties of up to 200% of the relieved duty, fines under the Customs Ordinance of up to GBP 50,000, and imprisonment for up to 7 years. Income Tax fraud and evasion provisions permit additional assessments equal to up to double the tax evaded plus daily interest at 8% per annum; the Cayman exempted company's exempt status does not shield a Gibraltar permanent establishment or branch from these penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) as banking and e-money supervisor; Bank of England as sovereign sterling monetary authority; HM Treasury as the exchange control authority
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Pound sterling and Gibraltar pound are fully convertible on both current-account and capital-account transactions. The UK and Gibraltar maintain no exchange controls, no pre-authorisation for profit/dividend remittances, and no restriction on the Cayman exempted company's receipt or retention of foreign currency. Compliance obligations are limited to AML/KYC source-of-funds verification, tax information reporting, and sanctions screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export-proceeds surrender rule and no mandatory conversion ratio in the UK or Gibraltar. Digital publishing receipts (Steam/PlayStation royalties) may be retained in any eligible currency indefinitely; the only hard deadlines are record-retention obligations under the Money Laundering Regulations (five years after business relationship ends).

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Moderate. A UK/EEA-licensed e-money institution (e.g., Wise for Business, Revolut Business) can be used to receive/route payments if its terms permit Cayman-exempted clients and if the beneficial owners pass KYC; however, any entity holding itself out as providing e-money services in Gibraltar requires a GFSC licence, which precludes unlicensed offshore EMI activity within Gibraltar. Legal constraints include safeguarding of client funds under Gibraltar's E-Money Regulations, post-Brexit passport restrictions, and refusal by many EMIs to onboard pure tax-exempt offshore vehicles without a genuine commercial rationale.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote opening is generally permitted through video-verified KYC and notarised corporate documents, but a physical interview may be required by private banks when the Cayman exempted company has non-Gibraltar directors or complex ownership. For low-risk digital-gaming royalty structures, most tier-2 Gibraltar banks and UK EMI platforms allow fully remote onboarding provided that the UBOs are in FATF-compliant jurisdictions and provide a legitimised source-of-funds narrative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Structure is a Cayman Exempted Company with tax-exempt status and no local taxation in Gibraltar.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, Register of Directors, Register of Members, UBO declaration, Board Resolution for account opening, constitutional documents, and an independent tax/commercial opinion explaining the legitimate use of the offshore entity for global Steam/PlayStation publishing royalties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Alleged absence of economic substance or shell-company red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan covering licensing, publishing, and distribution activities; commercial agreements with Valve Corporation and Sony Interactive Entertainment; marketing/support invoices; substance documentation such as a Gibraltar service provider engagement, registered office, and, where necessary, physical office or outsourced management functions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction volume of cross-border royalty payments from US/EU platform aggregators without tangible-supply invoices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Steam/Valve payout statements, PlayStation Store royalty reports, reconciled invoices/purchase orders, chain-of-title agreements evidencing the IP owner-to-publisher flow, and a legal opinion addressing royalty withholding and licensing nexus.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBOs or directors resident in sanctions-sensitive or non-FATF jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised proof of identity, latest bank statements of UBO/professional references, source-of-wealth declaration, negative-media screening report, and evidence of association with the Cayman entity via notarised deeds or corporate minutes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity/funding remittances must be initiated as SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder/beneficial owner’s bank to the Gibraltar account, quoting ISO 20022 / UK BOP purpose code for investment between affiliated enterprises (e.g., 'S3020 – Investment between affiliated enterprises') and the narrative 'Capital contribution to Cayman Exempted Co. – Steam/PlayStation publishing operations'. The beneficiary account name must match the registry name exactly, and the bank must receive the constitutional documents, shareholder resolution, source-of-funds evidence, and an affidavit of ultimate beneficial ownership before crediting the capital escrow account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For platform payouts and royalty settlements between Valve/Steam, Sony PlayStation, and the Cayman/Gibraltar treasury vehicle, the primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 (customer credit transfer) with MT202 COVER where an intermediate bank is used; domestic GBP clearing may also be routed via CHAPS; EUR flows may use SEPA(SCT); USD flows generally use Fedwire through a New York correspondent. Commercial letters of credit are not suitable for intangible digital-royalty payments and should be reserved for physical-goods-related merchandise sales; when used, they must be issued as irrevocable, confirmed at sight with SWIFT MT700 message type to a Gibraltar-nominated advising bank.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla over-the-counter FX forwards between GBP, USD, and EUR
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies with limited offshore convertibility, although not needed for GBP/USD/EUR
Cross-currency swaps for tenor-matched cash-flow hedging of platform royalty pipelines
FX options (European-style) and calendar spread structures governed by ISDA 2002 Master Agreement

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to £500 (approx. $650 USD) for late filing; repeated non-compliance may result in administrative strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit required for public companies and private companies exceeding £1 million turnover, £1 million balance sheet total, or employing more than 10 persons
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Gibraltar GAAP or IFRS as applicable

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation of beneficial ownership and share capital details submitted with the annual return under Gibraltar AML requirements

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 12.5% flat rate charged on chargeable profits (Gibraltar-source income only). A Cayman Exempted Company with no managed-and-controlled or permanent establishment activity in Gibraltar is taxable at nil; once it earns Gibraltar-source digital publishing profit (e.g., Steam/PlayStation payout routed through Gibraltar), the effective levy is 12.5%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday. Available reliefs: 100% capital allowances on qualifying computer equipment and IT infrastructure; enhanced R&D super-deduction for video game development expenditure; participation exemption for qualifying foreign dividend income; loss relief restricted as set out below. Resulting effective rate may fall below 12.5% where substantial development costs are incurred.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form CT-1 (Gibraltar Corporation Tax Return) filed through the Gibraltar Income Tax Office e-portal (iTax on HM Government of Gibraltar website)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Duty to file and settle within 9 months after the end of the chargeable accounting period. For a 31 December period-end, the filing and payment deadline is 30 September of the following year; the Commissioner may serve notice for an earlier return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company Registration Number (Registry of Companies No.) and Taxpayer Identification Number (TIQ/Income Tax reference)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert Gibraltar overseas company registration number; the Cayman exempted company's Cayman company number is entered in the supplementary notes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Chargeable accounting period: commencement and cessation date
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the deemed Gibraltar accounting period; for a non-resident entity, it is the period during which the permanent establishment carried on trade.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross trading income and receipts (Steam Valve and PlayStation Store payouts, less platform commissions)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only receipts attributable to Gibraltar-source trading or a Gibraltar PE; exclude foreign-source receivables and document the attribution policy.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable operating deductions: development costs, marketing, Steam platform fees, royalty payments, hosting, salaries of Gibraltar staff
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim deductions only if connected to the Gibraltar PE; intercompany royalties must be arm's-length and substantiated by a TP policy.
Non-resident may claim writing-down allowances only against Gibraltar PE assets; advise on pooling computer equipment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net chargeable profits (Box 3 less Boxes 4 and 5)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This box must reflect correctly apportioned branch profits before treaty relief; no set-off of foreign head-office losses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss relief brought forward/claimed and balancing charges
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses may be carried forward only 5 years and must be traceable to the same Gibraltar trade.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable at 12.5% and declaration signed by director, manager or tax agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident director must also execute Form IT-1 to appoint the local tax representative and receive any assessment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers an automatic penalty of GIP 5,000 and a daily surcharge of GIP 100 per day (subject to a GIP 100,000 cap). Deliberate concealment adds a tax-geared penalty of up to 100% of the tax understated and interest at 8% per annum; failure following formal notice is a criminal offence punishable by a fine of up to GIP 50,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 2 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Cayman Islands Annual Return (Form AFA) and Annual Fee — Cayman Financial Services Authority E-Services (CIMA online registry)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed with the Registrar within 30 days of the anniversary of incorporation; annual government fee payable by the same date or end of January for calendar-year filers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempted company name, ELF number (Entity Legal Form), Cayman registered office address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cayman law requires a registered office in Cayman; the Gibraltar principal place of business must be separately disclosed in the tax annex.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of exempted company shareholders and directors
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ownership is unrestricted; beneficial ownership data must be filed under the Cayman BO Regime.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Relevant activity classification and substance declaration (Cayman Economic Substance Law)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Cayman tax-exempted company that is tax resident in Gibraltar in respect of PE profits remains subject to Cayman ESR; declare the 'pure holding' or non-relevant activity status and appoint a Gibraltar-based representative.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: US$500 penalty for each late return plus reinstatement fee; non-payment of annual fee leads to striking off and dissolution, with all company assets vesting in the Crown (Cayman); directors become personally liable to restore the company and compensate creditors.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. Gibraltar imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a Gibraltar-resident or Gibraltar-PE company; a Cayman exempted company also pays no Cayman dividend tax or WHT, enabling tax-free upstream to shareholders in or outside the UK.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Notwithstanding the nil statutory WHT, where a shareholder or licensor invokes the UK-Gibraltar Double Taxation Arrangement or another DTA: (i) obtain a Gibraltar Tax Residence Certificate from the Commissioner of Income Tax; (ii) file the DTA relief schedule to Form CT-1; (iii) provide the counterparty's TRC and Form 6166/UK DTA claim where applicable; (iv) obtain written clearance from the Income Tax Office before the outward remittance. The protocol is purely administrative as there is no tax to withhold domestically.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT is 0% for IP royalties and debt interest in Gibraltar. Under the UK-Gibraltar DTA, UK-resident beneficial owners of royalties and interest pay no Gibraltar tax; for third-country treaties the applicable rates are typically 0%-10% depending on the DTA, and domestic nil-WHT applies where the recipient is a qualifying non-resident.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Gibraltar uses the Gibraltar pound (GIP). A Local File is mandatory when controlled transactions with the non-resident group exceed GIP 1,000,000 annually. A Master File is required when the group's global consolidated revenue exceeds GIP 75,000,000 and Gibraltar-related intra-group transactions exceed GIP 5,000,000. Documentation must be contemporaneous and delivered within 30 days of the Income Tax Officer's demand.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Gibraltar Economic Substance Regulations (Income Tax (Substance Requirements) Regulations 2019) apply fully. For Steam/console publishing, the core income generating activities (strategy decisions, distribution contracts with Valve/Sony, IP management) must be performed by paid staff physically in Gibraltar, supported by offices, board meetings, servers, and adequate expenditure. Annual substance filings are integrated into the CT-1 return.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of Steam/PlayStation payouts from the Gibraltar CT-1, misstating the PE profit attribution, or routing platform royalties through undisclosed nominee contracts to a zero-tax Cayman entity without arm's-length consideration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax-geared penalty of up to 100% of the tax evaded, interest at 8% per annum, criminal conviction fined up to GIP 50,000 (or the statutory multiple of unpaid tax), confiscation of proceeds under the Proceeds of Crime Act, and, in aggravated cases, imprisonment for up to 2 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced on fraud or sham: directors are jointly and severally liable for the concealed tax and penalty, personal bankruptcy proceedings may be commenced, travel bans and asset freezes are imposable under the Criminal Justice (Confiscation) framework, and custodial sentences up to 2 years (or longer for money-laundering predicate offences) may be ordered.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Cayman exempted company holding the Steam publishing rights but with no board meeting, no staff, no premises, and no IT infrastructure in Gibraltar, while directing all management from London or Dubai.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of GIP 10,000 for substance non-compliance, mandatory strike-off from the Gibraltar registry, denial of treaty residence certificates, disqualification of the company from the publishing trade, and any surviving entity taxed on a deemed basis; the Cayman ESR parallel penalty is US$10,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Regulators hold directors specifically liable for knowingly certifying false substance returns; culpable directors face a civil restitution order up to the value of profits earned outside Gibraltar, a 5-year directorship ban and removal from the Register of Directors, and a custodial sanction for perjury or false statutory declaration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing and Manipulation of Arm's-Length Principle
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying excessive platform aggregator commissions, intra-group licensing fees, or financing charges to the Cayman parent to strip the Gibraltar gross margin below the arm's-length range; failure to submit Local/Master Files after service of notice.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Adjustment of the taxable profits upward to the median arm's-length figure, penalty of 50%-100% of the transfer pricing adjustment, late-payment interest from the original due date, and publication of the adjustment in the official gazette for repeated defaults.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The Commissioner may issue a personal notice of liability to a director who signed a transfer pricing return knowing the price was not arm's-length; the director's personal assets may be attached after unsatisfied corporate demand, and a deliberate overpricing scheme that defrauds revenue is prosecuted as tax fraud with imprisonment up to 2 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML, Proceeds of Crime and Sanctions Violation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting Steam/PlayStation settlement payouts into the Gibraltar/EMI account without a compliant AML/KYC file, neglecting beneficial ownership registration, or processing publisher royalties to a sanctioned jurisdiction through layered wallets in the Cayman entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Regulatory fine up to 5% of annual turnover under the financial services enforcement code, revocation of the EMI/banking licence and blocking of payment rails, criminal forfeiture of the transactions, and monetary penalties under the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Duty to report suspicious activity is statutory; omission is an indictable offence. Directors face personal fines, confiscation of personal assets, travel restrictions imposed by the Gibraltar Court pending investigation, and imprisonment up to 14 years for money laundering or sanctions evasion offences.
